description: Results include live optionAdjusted OAS with model assumptions when a curve is available. Run what-if bond analytics from exactly one supplied price, YTM, G-spread, or Z-spread for each bond. YTM is percent, semi-annual bond-equivalent (S.A.) for every bond; spreads are basis points on the same basis, except EUR bonds, whose spreads are over the Bund curve on the annual basis (spreads.benchmark BUND, yields.ytmAnnual); and prices are per 100 face. Yield conventions: https://bondterminal.com/methodology/yields Maximum 50 bonds per call. Billing: 1 calculation unit per bond.

bonds.description: Up to 50 bonds, each with an identifier and exactly one of price, ytm, gSpread or zSpread.

identifier.description: ISIN, CUSIP, ticker or Argentine local ticker (for example AL30 or GD30).

ytm.description: Yield to maturity in percent, semi-annual bond-equivalent (S.A.).

settlement.description: Settlement date, YYYY-MM-DD, years 2020 to 2100. Omitted, each bond uses its standard settlement.
